disposition_reason: Tables 2 and 3 print mean ± SD lead and cadmium (mg/kg) in liver, kidney and muscle of cattle, sheep and goats sampled at the Tamale abattoir, Ghana.

study.design: Abattoir survey of liver, kidney and muscle from locally reared cattle, sheep and goats (three samples per organ per species) with average daily dose and cancer-risk estimates
study.origin: Locally reared animals, Tamale Metropolis, Northern Region, Ghana
study.method: Washed, sun- and oven-dried (105 °C), ground; HNO3/HClO4 digestion; graphite furnace AAS
study.lod_text: not reported (results below it printed as BDL)
study.qa: No CRM, recovery or blank data reported

unresolved: Text says cadmium was found in all samples except goat muscle, but Table 3 prints goat muscle Cd 0.13 ± 0.08 mg/kg.
Table 3 SDs equal the means for cattle liver Pb (7.06 ± 7.06) and sheep liver Pb (2.46 ± 2.46), consistent with only one of three samples detected; per-sample values not printed.
LOD and the dry or wet basis are not reported; the cited 'permissible limits' (WHO 0.01 mg/kg Pb) are not standard food limits.
Table 4 ADD column carries the label mg/kg; these are intake estimates, not concentrations, and were not extracted.
Journal issue printed as Volume 7 No. 2, 2020; the manifest gives 2021.
